cards.text: The envelope is heavy for paper and cream-coloured. The address is a Firm-owned betting shop in Soho. Nobody there will be pleased to see it.

cards.speaker: Fairweather
cards.text: "Hand it over the counter. Say nothing. If they open it in front of you, that's their business."
The counter is a long way from the door.

choices.label: Walk in and hand it over

success.result_text: The cashier takes it without looking up. You are three streets away before anyone looks at you.

fail.result_text: A man by the fruit machine recognises the envelope, then you. The envelope arrives. You leave faster than it did.

choices.label: Take it to the Firm's man, unopened, and ask what it's worth
choices.result_text: Lusk's man holds it up to the light and smiles. "Tell them we said thank you." The Conclave will hear about this by lunch.

cards.text: Soho carries on, as it does.
